stories.summary: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week. Ukraine now has a "stable connection" to Starlink, its defence minister has said, after its military suffered days of restricted connectivity on the satellite network. Kyiv relies on the Starlink and its military-grade counterpart Starshield for piloting drones and operations within Ukraine, but last week accused US President Donald Trump of telling owner Elon Musk to place limits on it. This meant drones would lose connection when travelling at 161km/h (100mph) or more, it said. Trump denied doing so before saying Musk had "put it back".

stories.title: Dexter Lawrence has a plan for stopping Derrick Henry
stories.summary: Cincinnati can’t let the Ravens running back get to the second level. The centerpiece of the run defense, Dexter Lawrence, talked about what his unit's strategy will be to slow down the Baltimore Ravens running back. He told Mike Petraglia that the emphasis in practice on Wednesday was tackling. "We got to wrap him up, and we got to bring him down," he said. "He's a big dude running the ball." "We got to build a wall and keep him behind it."
